items.title: Rockstar Dumps Nearly 40 Spectacular New GTA 6 Screenshots Ahead Of Launch
items.summary: Rockstar released a launch gallery of nearly 40 new screenshots two weeks before the November 19 release.

items.title: Massive GTA 6 Mural Tagged By Graffiti Artist Overnight And People Aren't Happy
items.summary: A graffiti artist named Jelous tagged the large Rockstar-commissioned GTA 6 mural in Brooklyn and posted it on Instagram, and many fans reacted angrily.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto 6's New Launch Screen Shots Have Strippers, Raves, Guns, and More
items.summary: Alongside the new launch gallery, a YouTuber's preview points to a "photo studio mode", which could make GTA 6 the first GTA with an official photo mode.

items.title: GTA 6 Looks Pretty Realistic, Until It Comes To Gym Etiquette
items.summary: A GameSpot writer jokes about the poor gym hygiene of the shirtless, sweaty Jason in one of the newly released launch screenshots.

items.title: Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick isn't too concerned about piracy ahead of GTA 6 even if he is 'worried about everything all the time'
items.summary: In a WSJ interview, Zelnick called piracy a fact of life, said server-connected games and large file sizes limit it, and said Take-Two will respond with legal and technical measures if it becomes a problem.

items.title: GTA 6 Boss Talks The Game's Budget And Calls Out A "High-Profile" Game For Releasing In A Rough State
items.summary: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick told the WSJ the game was expensive and took a long time, and that he won't claim success before launch.

items.title: PlayStation Leaks GTA 6 PS5 Pro Enhancements
items.summary: A PlayStation France listing, since removed, named only PSSR upscaling and advanced ray tracing as PS5 Pro features, though it may contain copy-paste errors.

items.title: Has GTA 6 Been Delayed Again Before Release?
items.summary: Insider Gaming says there is no new delay, noting review copies are with outlets and the November 19 date stands.

items.title: GTA 6 Has Already Sold Nearly 8 Million Copies, One Data Firm Claims
items.summary: Sensor Tower estimates 7.71 million pre-order sales and about $751 million in revenue, with roughly 74% of copies on PS5 and 26% on Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: GTA 6 Will Not Actually Come To Stores Sooner
items.summary: Rockstar briefly said boxed code-in-a-box copies would hit stores on November 10, then reverted that to November 12, while pre-loading was moved up to November 10 and the game still can't be played until November 19.
